Problem: Argument-free beat tasks scan tenant tables after prerun sets an empty app.company_id. With FORCE RLS the scans match nothing and return success.
Root Cause: These sweeps never call iter_company_ids/set_rls_company or rls_bypass. Sibling beats do. SQLite tests no-op the GUC.
User Impact: Turning RLS on stops contract expiry updates and recurring draft invoices with no error. RLS off (current prod examples) still works.
Reproduction: POSTGRES_RLS_ENABLED=1 on Postgres. Due contract and due recurring schedule. Run both tasks with no args. Zero updates. Flag off: both move rows.
Recommended Fix: Loop companies and set_rls_company per company. Postgres RLS test that due rows change.
Regression Risk: Per-company loop is slower; keep RecurringInvoiceRun period_key idempotency; do not let status update clear CANCELLED.

Problem: Issuing a second option on the same option set creates a second in-force policy. Idempotency only checks that option's own policies.
Root Cause: Uniqueness is per Policy.option, not per option set or lead.
User Impact: One prospect is covered twice and consumes two policy numbers and two premiums.
Reproduction: Choose option A, issue, choose option B, issue. Two IN_FORCE policies.
Recommended Fix: Lock the option set and reject when any option already has a live policy.
Regression Risk: A second policy on a different option set for the same customer must still be allowed.

Problem: Renewal leads are deduped by a racy exists() on customer name and a message prefix. No policy FK and no unique constraint.
Root Cause: String match instead of a foreign key. Two transactions can both pass exists().
User Impact: Parallel diary runs duplicate leads. Renaming the customer or editing the message duplicates or suppresses the renewal.
Reproduction: Two parallel diary posts for one in-window policy create two leads. Rename the customer and post again for a third.
Recommended Fix: UniqueConstraint from the generated lead to the policy. Treat IntegrityError as already created.
Regression Risk: First run after deploy may insert one catch-up lead per in-window policy.

User Impact: A 12-month policy from 2026-01-01 ends 2026-12-27. Cover and renewal are early.
Reproduction: Issue tenure_months=12 start 2026-01-01. end_date is 2026-12-27 not 2027-01-01.
Recommended Fix: Add calendar months or store an adviser-supplied end date. Backfill only rows that still match the 30-day formula.
Regression Risk: Moving existing end dates shifts renewal windows. Dry-run the migration.

Problem: Milestone is marked INVOICED against a DRAFT sales invoice. Any non-null FK blocks re-invoice, including a cancelled draft. Close treats the link as billed.
Root Cause: Has-a-row was treated as revenue posted. SalesService.complete is never called.
User Impact: Project looks billed. Receivables do not move. The milestone cannot be invoiced again.
Reproduction: Invoice a ready milestone, cancel or abandon the draft, invoice again, then close. Same draft id; project CLOSED.
Recommended Fix: Set INVOICED only after COMPLETED, or clear the FK on cancel. Close refuses non-completed invoices.
Regression Risk: Auto-complete surfaces GST Guard and credit-limit errors on this action. Do not swallow them.

Problem: Navigation uses the first milestone salesInvoice on the project, not the milestone that was posted.
Root Cause: The click's milestone id is discarded. find(Boolean) picks the first linked invoice.
User Impact: Invoicing a later milestone opens the previous invoice. The operator completes the wrong document.
Reproduction: Milestone A already invoiced, B ready. Invoice B. Router opens A's invoice.
Recommended Fix: Select the milestone id that was posted. Component test with two milestones.

Problem: Credit note, return, and replacement order are saved as drafts. APPROVED can still move to RESOLVED. Transitions are not row-locked.
Root Cause: Serializer create is not the complete service. Resolution checks that a row exists.
User Impact: A resolved complaint leaves the customer balance unchanged. The report counts it as closed with a document.
Reproduction: create-credit-note then transition RESOLVED. Note stays DRAFT. Outstanding unchanged.
Recommended Fix: Resolve only when the linked document is completed. select_for_update on transition.
Regression Risk: Completion will surface GST and stock errors on the complaint action.

Problem: Rewards quantize to whole rupees (Decimal 1) while the ledger uses paise.
User Impact: Referrers are off by up to fifty paise per deal.
Recommended Fix: Quantize to 0.01 with the tax engine's rounding. Do not recompute PAID rows.
Regression Risk: Pending rows keep old amounts unless backfilled.

Problem: SLA is extended only when leaving WAITING. During WAITING the original deadline still looks breached. Reopen does not start a new clock.
Root Cause: Pause is retroactive on exit instead of applied while waiting_since is set.
User Impact: Agents show in breach during a customer hold. Reopened tickets are immediately overdue.
Reproduction: MEDIUM ticket, move to WAITING, advance past sla_due_at. Overdue queries include it.
Recommended Fix: Overdue reads add the open wait. Reopen sets a fresh sla_due_at from SLA_OFFSETS.
Regression Risk: Do not rewrite historical timestamps; change the read formula.

Problem: Garbage sequence, unknown milestone, or bad start_date/within_days raise ValueError or AttributeError and return 500.
Root Cause: Actions parse request.data without serializers or get_object_or_404.
User Impact: Bad input looks like an outage.
Reproduction: POST milestone sequence x; POST ready on milestone 999999; POST policy start_date tomorrow. All 500.
Recommended Fix: Request serializers and company-scoped 404/400. Map BusinessRuleError on these viewsets.
Regression Risk: Numeric strings that int() accepts keep working.

Problem: With an empty webhook secret, DJANGO_ENV=test accepts any unsigned body. The X-Bizboard-Test-Webhook check is unreachable.
Root Cause: The header condition is AND env != test, which contradicts the branch that already returned for non-test.
User Impact: A public host left in the test env with no secret accepts forged billing events. Prod/staging with a non-test env still 403.
Reproduction: DJANGO_ENV=test, empty secret, POST webhook with no signature and no test header. Not 403.
Recommended Fix: Require the test header whenever the secret is empty, including the test env.
Regression Risk: Fixtures that omitted the header must send it.

Problem: Amount is unvalidated. Negatives are stored. Repeats insert another receivable. Non-numeric input is a 500.
Root Cause: Custom action skipped serializers and idempotency.
User Impact: Commission receivable can be negative or duplicated inside the tenant.
Reproduction: POST commission amount -1 twice. Two rows. POST amount nope. 500.
Recommended Fix: Decimal > 0, idempotency scope including policy id, 400 on bad input.
Regression Risk: String decimals such as 100.50 should still parse.

Problem: Milestone fields are shared across every open project. No Close button. Insurance list hides end date and leaves Issue armed after success.
Root Cause: Single page-level state and a happy-path form that omits the rest of the API.
User Impact: Milestone text is applied to the wrong project. Cover end date (DR-004) is invisible. Second issue is one click away (DR-002).
Reproduction: Two projects: typing a milestone name fills both cards. Issue a policy: list shows number and status only.
Recommended Fix: Per-project state, Close action, render endDate, clear chosen after issue, disable buttons while pending.
Regression Risk: Existing flag-off page test still applies.

Problem: Stored contract status is only refreshed by the beat or by save(). GET does not recompute. QuerySet.update in the beat skips save().
Root Cause: Status is a cache with a single writer that DR-001 can disable.
User Impact: Lists and reports show ACTIVE for contracts that have already ended, for up to a day even when RLS is off, and indefinitely when RLS is on.
Reproduction: Create a contract ending yesterday. GET ?status=ACTIVE without running the beat. It is returned.
Recommended Fix: Derive status on read (preserve CANCELLED) or make the beat RLS-safe and frequent enough to match the product promise.
Regression Risk: Deriving on read must not turn CANCELLED into EXPIRED.
